own_solution.law: Double Doppler shift: f2 = f(c-w)(c-v)/(c(c+w)); shift = f - f2 = f*7149/119707.
assumptions: reflection with no frequency change in panel frame

defect_reasons.other: TBF04/TA0C8 change the note near the time of pickup, which strictly admits a transient reading (crests picked up just after the change were emitted at the old pitch), though the intended steady reading is clear.

notes: Verified crest-timing relations: t_h = (q + c t)/(c - w) and T_n = (q + (c+w) t_h)/(c - v) are correct for a recorder starting at the post and moving away from the lorry; T_(n+1)-T_n = c(c+w)/(f(c-w)(c-v)), so q cancels and the shift is f*7149/119707 = 89.5812 Hz. R values checked: 1670 Hz -> 99.7338, 1910 Hz -> 114.067, 2260 Hz -> 134.969. Disagreement with my pass 1: I labelled the 82 m distance D; the authors' C label is better justified, since q appears in the arrival-time relations of the system and cancels from the period; the answer is unchanged either way. Minimal pairs T02E2/TBF04 and T4BE2/TA0C8 share 410 Hz and differ only in attachment; TA134/TA6A4 are declared numeral-free controls. TDC03/T6307 differ only in 'stands'/'is'.
